hero-heavy.name: Template A — Hero Heavy
hero-heavy.description: Full-viewport immersive hero with transparent overlaid header. No subnav, no breadcrumb. Editorial, magazine-like feel with generous whitespace below. All persuasion happens above the fold.

top-banner.example: FREE SHIPPING on orders $99+ | FREE Jersey Assurance on all jerseys

promo-bar.description: Supporting copy centred in the hero below the headline
promo-bar.example: Get the same jerseys the players wear on the field. Officially licensed, shipped free.

hero-image.description: Full-viewport background image behind the hero content
hero-image.example: Team action shot, stadium photo, or player celebration

hero-headline.description: Large centred headline (56px) over the hero image

hero-subheadline.example: San Francisco Giants · Official Nike Jerseys

hero-cta.description: CTA button text centred in the hero

full-surround.name: Template B — Full Surround
full-surround.description: Dark-themed top section with countdown timer and live activity ticker. Dense messaging at every scroll position — urgency bars, callout banners, aggregate review bars, stacked trust. Hard conversion feel.

top-banner.description: Blue animated banner at the very top
top-banner.example: FREE SHIPPING on orders $99+ | FREE Jersey Assurance on all jerseys

countdown.description: Countdown timer strip below the dark header — counts down to an event or deadline
countdown.example: Giants vs. Dodgers — Game Day In: 11d 04h 32m

promo-bar.example: 12,847 sold this season — 97% of fans recommend

hero-image.description: Small image in the compact horizontal hero card
hero-image.example: Team photo or player action shot

hero-headline.description: Headline in the compact hero card

hero-subheadline.description: Eyebrow text in the compact hero card

hero-cta.description: CTA button in the compact hero card

badge.description: Floating label overlaid on the product image

ticker.description: Scrolling live activity feed in the PDP info column
ticker.example: Mike in SF bought this 3 min ago | 23 people viewing right now | Only 8 left in size M

callout-1.description: Inline banner between PDP and product grid
callout-1.example: Giants vs. Dodgers — Apr 8-10 at Oracle Park. Get game-day ready.

callout-2.description: Inline banner between product grid and reviews
callout-2.example: Bundle & Save: Add a cap (+$34.99) and get free shipping

reviews-headline.description: Reviews section heading above the aggregate star bar
reviews-headline.example: What Fans Say About Chapman Jerseys

trust-bar.description: Four-column trust bar with icons, labels, and descriptions
trust-bar.example: ✓ Official MLB Licensed | 🚚 Free Shipping $99+ | ↩️ 365-Day Returns | 🔒 Secure Checkout
